title: Cedric Price : a selective bibliography (draft)
body:
Title Cedric Price : a selective bibliography (draft) compiled and updated by the POA, February 2011.

Corporate Author Architectural Association (Great Britain).

Publication Information London : Architectural Association, 2011.

Source Presented Public Occasion Agency.

Physical Description 1 v. (various pag.) : ill. (chiefly col.), maps, plans ; 30 cm.

General Note This bibliography consists of a selective list of journal articles relating to Cedric Price from 1961 to 2010 (arranged chronologically by year and month), and copies of the articles. In paper folder.

Date Captured 7.3.2011

Personal Subject Price, Cedric.

Local Subject Bibliography. Architecture--20th century Architects--20th century--Great Britain. Architects--20th century--England.

Place England.

 

Language English.
